web.tool_reclass_tip: Re-sort photos and videos waiting for review, using the current categories and your corrections
web.tool_index_plain_tip: Make files received with “Send” searchable too
web.export_tip: Select items to copy to another folder or save as a ZIP
web.onedrive: The files folder is inside OneDrive, so received photos will be uploaded to the cloud. To avoid that, choose another location in Tools › Files Location.
web.search_ph: Search inside photos, videos and documents, like “sunset at the beach” or “booking code”
web.img_search_tip: Choose an image, or drag one here, to find similar items
web.vid_fail: This video format can’t play in the browser, so a still from that moment is shown.
web.lb_send_tip: Send this item back to your phone
web.loc_help: Files from your phone and the search index are kept in this folder, separate from the app. Changing the location doesn’t move any files: to keep your existing files, move the whole folder in File Explorer first, then choose it here. If you choose a folder that already has other files, a “Xun-Qi” folder is created inside it.
web.sp_lib_d: Send items you received back to your phone. Files are checked for changes before sending.
web.sp_pc_d: Choose any file or folder on this PC, or drag them in. They’re only sent, not added to the library.
web.exp_help: A new “Xun-Qi Export” folder with the date and time is created in the folder you choose, and the selected items are copied into it. Your original files stay where they are, and nothing is overwritten.
web.cat_help: Describe each category in a few lines (one per line, in English or Chinese). The AI weighs them all, so the more specific, the better. Renaming a category moves its folder too. Deleting a category moves its items to Unsorted; no files are deleted. Put an emoji in the box on the left, or leave it empty to use the built-in icon.
web.cat_desc_ph:
One per line, for example:
kids playing
baby photos
a photo of a child playing
web.bk_help: A backup saves how your library is organized — categories, review status, your corrections, custom categories, the search index and the device certificates used by your phone — but not the photos themselves. Backups are saved in the files folder; keeping an extra copy on a USB drive or in the cloud is a good idea. Before restoring, the current state is backed up automatically. Restart the app to finish restoring.
web.sd_pc_help: Files you choose are read from where they are, not copied. Dragged files are kept only until they’re sent.
web.sd_scan_tip: If your phone doesn’t show up, ask each device on the network (about 10 seconds)
web.sd_help: Your phone appears when it’s on the same Wi‑Fi as this PC with LocalSend open on screen. After you click Send, tap Accept on the phone to start. To save straight to Photos, turn on “Save to gallery” in LocalSend’s settings on the phone.
web.lang_help: The interface changes right away. The device names your phone sees and the text in the black console window update the next time you start the app. Existing categories and folder names stay the same.
